model_plan.inputs: Measured differential and common-mode input voltage, VDD waveform; per-condition/per-resistor-mode/per-stage model. Only replay input initializes cascades.
model_plan.model: A=A0*exp(kcm*(cm-cmref)+k2*(vin^2-d2ref)); g=g0*sqrt(A/A0)*exp(kg*(cm-cmref)); targetD=A*tanh(g*vin/A); targetCM=VDD-A/2; both outputs first-order lowpass(tau) after explicit input delay.
model_plan.fitting: 1ps resampling, prior replay history settles model; 3.5–6.4ns residuals; differential error scale 10mV and CM error scale 5mV; held-out combined point excluded from fitting.
measurements: absolute crossings and complete causal event coverage
model_plan.qualification: Exploratory surrogate only. Report fit and complete-case holdout residuals, failed associations, bound-active parameters and unphysical predictions. No prediction interval or physical size adoption.
model_plan.scope: FS hot and SS cold only; fixed WN24/24/32 and WT15.6/15.6/16; 3 discrete resistor implementations; prescribed bias and omitted upstream feedback.

circuit_only_observables.scope: Measured from transistor simulations in the source review; not predicted by this surrogate.

initial_guesses: baseline-derived A0; g0=1.5, kcm=k2=kg=0; (tau,delay) ps=(15,5),(35,1); least training cost

limitations: Only FS hot and SS cold; three discrete R implementations, fixed WN/WT and prescribed voltage inputs.
No R or device-size interpolation, original source is a rejected full-TX clock iteration.
Clock loads only use fixed cards; downstream final slice/driver still use frozen generic loads.
No upstream impedance, bias feedback, shared supply response, PEX, mismatch or noise prediction.
Empirical complete-point holdout error is not a prediction interval or guaranteed design margin.
CM formula is approximate; bound-active fits, ill conditioning and rail excursions are reported.
Full serializer/pad eye, full payload mapping and physical size adoption remain separate.
